postconditions.expression: all(s_i in ['E', 'N'] for s_i in s)
postconditions.description: Each character in the string s is either 'E' or 'N'.
The number of test cases t is between 1 and 1000.
The size of the array n is between 2 and 50.

invariants.description: The length of the string s is equal to the size of the array n.
